text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her local idol activities and training as 
a dirt Umamusume. Hokko Tarumae diligently 
applied herself to both, steadily 
expanding her fanbase.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, Hokko Tarumae reveals 
that watching last year's "Tokyo 
Daishoten" made her admire Smart Falcon's 
running and inspired her to chase after 
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, witnessing Wonder Acute's run, 
Hokko Tarumae was completely overwhelmed. 
She grew anxious about whether she could 
ever contend with such running, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey appears. While acknowledging 
Wonder Acute's greatness, she declares 
it's no reason to give up on her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by that attitude, Hokko Tarumae 
fired herself up again, ready to move 
fearlessly toward her dream...!
